summary: Closed the remaining SPA auth persistence gap by returning a bearer token from backend registration and restoring the legacy AuthContext suite under Vitest/App Router mocks.

changes.summary: Registration now creates and returns a Sanctum bearer token in data.token, matching login.
Registration asserts token presence and proves the returned token can access /api/v1/auth/user.
Migrated legacy mocks to Vitest/App Router-safe vi.mock usage and fixed the duplicate-login regression to use an overlapping in-flight request.

validation.details: Next.js static export build completed successfully

notes: The remaining acceptance risk is browser-only verification of the same-origin export/proxy flow after registration and subsequent navigation to /sites/{siteId}/local.
Vitest still logs existing act-environment warnings from the legacy AuthContext suite, but the suite now passes end-to-end.
